event_verification_v1.Bass: 28/30 matched (misses: repeated same-pitch G3 downbeats — detector blind to same-pitch repeats)

timing_C.tempo_map: 100->72->100 at LMMS ticks 0/768/1296 (SMF 0/7680/12960): APPLIED AND AUDIBLY VERIFIED (onset spacing changes at bar 5; bar-7 and bar-8 onsets at 16.2s/18.77s match the 72 BPM segment)

timing_C.bar_references: bar5=768, bar8=1296 LMMS ticks confirmed in generated .mmp
timing_C.render_length_rule: measured 24.166s = content end (19.97s) + song-end pad: LMMS renders to pattern end (1536 ticks = 21.77s on the tempo timeline) plus one extra bar (432 ticks = 5.4s at the mapped tempo) — length is deterministic but includes the pad

stem_mix_routing_B.finding: stems and mix BOTH pass the master-volume stage (per-stem sha256 changes when mastervol changes: mv65 vs mv100 renders differ); mix = master-bus sum of all track outputs
stem_mix_routing_B.clipping_cause: initial stems clipped at track level (osc vol 200 overdrove TripleOscillator buffers: stem maxima 32767 with flat tops) — track clipping precedes mixing, so sum-of-clipped-stems != clipped-sum; RMS 7775-class discrepancies explained
stem_mix_routing_B.after_headroom_fix: stem maxima 29227/16612/798/798 (no clipping); best-fit mix/sum scale 0.9812 at mastervol 65, residual rms 622 (~-27dB rel) attributable to int16 per-render quantization and LMMS nonlinear master taper (mv65->100 measured gain ratio 1.3486, not 1.538 linear)
stem_mix_routing_B.rule: give every track headroom (osc+track levels near unity); never assert bit-exact stem-sum-to-mix; verify by event alignment (wav_note_check), not by sample sum

edit_v2.note_diff: exactly the intended edit: Flute 7 notes +12 semitones (bars 3-4 octave up); Bass 6, PianoRH 4, PianoLH 4 notes changed at bars 6-7 (D7->Em); nothing else changed; duration identical 24.166168s
edit_v2.flute_stem_check: 12/12 onsets matched, zero unmatched — the octave-up edit is audibly verified at every event
